SOFTWARE ENGINEER \- DATAPATH
   

  

*Turn a customer’s intent into a live, multi\-cloud network — automatically, anywhere in the world — and learn the entire stack while you do it.*
 THE MISSION
   

  

 When a company connects its data centers, clouds, and offices on Alkira, our team is what makes it happen. The customer tells us what they want — connect these networks, across these clouds, with these policies — and we turn that into a real, working network in minutes instead of weeks, automatically.
   

  

 We’re the Playbooks / Orchestration team, and we build that automation. Using a mix of Ansible, Python, and Go, we set up the networking stack on our Cloud Exchange Points (CXPs) and run the workflows that keep it healthy — including tricky operations like safely restarting a node. We bring up new virtual network functions (VNFs), build the tooling and CLI used to inspect and configure each node, and work closely with the Routing, Data Path, and Backend teams. Our team spans the US and India, and above all we make sure every customer network comes up correctly and reliably, across every cloud.
   

  

 LOCATION: This is a hybrid work environment that requires onsite at San Jose office on Tuesdays and Thursdays
   

  

**What You’ll Work On**
* Automate the cloud. Write the Ansible playbooks that provision infrastructure and stand up network services across AWS, Azure, and GCP — VPCs/VNets, subnets, tunnels, NAT, routing, and security policy.
* Build the engines. Develop the Go task engines that push this configuration onto the CXP nodes at scale — running provisioning and teardown against live state, and rebuilding a node’s entire configuration after a controlled restart.
* Bring up new capabilities. Integrate new VNFs as we light up new services and capabilities.
* Own the tooling. Build the Python tooling and CLI engineers use to inspect, configure, and debug the networking stack on the nodes.
* Model the work. Extend the configuration and task models that translate a single provisioning request into the exact commands applied on the nodes.
* Keep it fast and correct. Help connectivity stay correct, fast, and reliable across clouds and at scale.
* Solve real problems. Chase tricky production provisioning issues to their root cause and drive the fix — and collaborate with Routing, Data Path, and Backend on how configuration flows end to end.


*You won’t touch all of this on day one. Most engineers start in one layer and grow outward fast.*
**Who You Are**
 We’re looking for a well\-rounded Software Engineer with a basic grounding in networking technologies. Our stack spans several layers — Ansible playbooks, Go task engines, Python tooling, the networking stack on the nodes — and sits right next to the C\-based data path. You don’t need to be an expert in all of it. Bring strong fundamentals and real curiosity about how networks and clouds work, and you’ll start in one layer and grow into the rest.
   

  

**You'll Thrive Here If You Have**
* Strong software fundamentals — data structures, problem\-solving, clean code, and the patience to debug. Hands\-on coding in at least one of C, Python, or Go, and the appetite to pick up the others — we use all three everyday, and the engineers who range across them go furthest.
* Comfort on Linux — the shell, processes, logs, and the everyday networking tools.
* Hands\-on familiarity with core networking — TCP/IP, and the curiosity to go deeper.
* A working mental model of the cloud — at least one of AWS, Azure, or GCP: what a VPC/VNet, subnet, and security group actually are.
* A debugging mindset — you genuinely enjoy chasing a problem until you find the real cause.


 Bonus Points
   

  

* Ansible or other configuration\-automation experience.
* You use AI\-assisted development tools like Claude Code — we lean on them to build workflows, write debug tooling, and move faster across the entire software development lifecycle.
* Experience building CLIs, task runners, or automation that runs at scale.
* Familiarity with firewalls, load balancers, and similar network services.


 WHY YOU’LL GROW FAST HERE
   

  

 The orchestration layer touches every part of the system — clouds, Linux, the networking stack, and the data path next door. That makes it one of the best vantage points in the company for an early\-career engineer: you’ll get unusually broad exposure, work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with networking and systems experts, and build a deep, end\-to\-end picture of how a real cloud network works. Strong all\-rounders here don’t stay in one lane — they move fluidly between layers and become the people who understand how the whole thing fits together.
   

  

 ON\-CALL
   

  

 On\-call is a mandatory part of this role. You’ll join the orchestration on\-call rotation and help debug and resolve
   

  

 production provisioning issues, with coverage coordinated across the US and India. It’s also where a lot of the
   

  

 deepest learning happens — there’s no faster way to understand a system than to keep it running.
   

  

**About Alkira**
 Alkira, a Lumen company, is building the future of enterprise networking: one programmable platform to connect, secure, and operate every cloud, site, partner, data center, and AI workload.
   

  

 Founded by Amir and Atif Khan, the creators of Viptela and pioneers of the SD\-WAN market, Alkira was built to radically simplify how enterprises deploy and manage network infrastructure. Today, as part of Lumen, we are bringing that cloud\-native operating model to a global network foundation trusted by the world’s largest enterprises.
   

  

 Our platform helps customers move faster without managing hardware, stitching together providers, or operating fragmented cloud networks. Teams can build and scale connectivity on demand, apply consistent security and segmentation, and gain visibility across distributed environments from one place.
   

  

 At Alkira, you’ll help shape the next chapter of networking: cloud\-like consumption, private\-network performance, and total control across the enterprise. We move fast, solve hard problems, and build technology that changes how global businesses connect.
   

  

 Join us and help build the future of networking.

**Job Title:** 
 Senior Data Scientist
 **Company:** 
 Reach Latent
 **Location:** 
 Remote
 **Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 **Salary:** 
 $90,000\-130,000/year
 



**About Us** 
 Latent AI is a leading AI solutions implementation partner with an established and diverse international client base, dedicated to solving complex challenges through cutting\-edge technology. Our strength lies in our global workforce – comprising small, agile, and expert teams distributed around the world who deliver bespoke AI and machine learning solutions. We foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and deep technical excellence that connects our talent and clients across borders.
 



**Company Website:** 
 https://www.reachlatent.com/
 



**The Role** 
 We are seeking an experienced and proactive Senior Data Scientist to join our team. This role focuses on transforming complex datasets into actionable insights and building robust machine learning solutions, with a strong emphasis on rigorous experimentation, statistical rigor, and timely delivery. The ideal candidate is comfortable exploring messy real\-world datasets, designing experiments, developing and optimizing predictive models, and communicating findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences. This role suits someone who is proactive, intellectually curious, and can work independently.
 



**What You’ll Do** 



* **Modeling \& Analysis:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end development of machine learning and statistical models, from problem framing and feature engineering through to evaluation, iteration, and handoff to production.
* **Data Exploration \& Pipeline Collaboration:** 
 Dive deep into complex datasets to surface insights and work closely with engineers to define and validate the data pipelines that feed model development.
* **Benchmarking \& Evaluation:** 
 Design and maintain robust evaluation frameworks for models, providing data\-driven insights that inform modeling decisions, vendor selection, and architectural trade\-offs.
* **Structured Experimentation:** 
 Hypothesize, design, implement, and measure experiments to identify optimal modeling approaches and generate actionable optimization steps.
* **Technical Point of Contact:** 
 Serve as the data science lead on projects, engaging directly with customers’ R\&D and analytics teams, translating their business questions into well\-defined modeling problems and driving tangible impact through your expertise.
* **Project Delivery Oriented:** 
 Hold a deep sense of accountability for your analysis and models, their quality, and timely delivery. Own the design, planning, and execution of the data science workstreams.



**Who You Are** 



* **Collaborative Contributor:** 
 You identify gaps, define clear assumptions, and raise critical flags early to ensure team alignment and project progress.
* **Execution\-Focused Builder:** 
 You own tasks from inception to completion, translating ambiguous business questions into rigorous analyses and models that consistently meet production standards.
* **Proactive Communicator:** 
 You engage stakeholders and team members directly; rather than waiting for information, you seek it out to keep momentum moving forward.
* **Analytical Problem Solver:** 
 You contribute meaningfully to technical discussions and offer actionable recommendations, maintaining a clear path forward even when navigating ambiguity.
* **Continuous Learner:** 
 You stay at the forefront of the field by actively reviewing academic papers and emerging research to integrate the latest advances in ML and data science into your work.



**Qualifications** 



* Master’s in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, or similar experience.
* Strong foundation in statistical modeling, machine learning, and model evaluation techniques.
* Proficiency in designing and running structured experiments, including A/B testing and causal inference methods.
* Hands\-on experience with supervised and unsupervised learning across a range of problem types (classification, regression, clustering, time\-series, etc.).
* Experience working with LLMs and GenAI techniques as tools within the data science workflow.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, capable of translating complex analytical findings into clear, actionable narratives for technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Strong programming skills in Python, including the data science stack (pandas, scikit\-learn, etc.).
* Comfort working with and querying large datasets using SQL or similar tools.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a healthy skepticism toward results.
* Ability to work in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
* Proven ability to work independently, proactively own outcomes, and contribute effectively as part of a small, close\-knit team.



**Why Join Us?** 
 Join a team of top\-tier engineers and scientists at a pivotal moment of growth. At Latent AI, we move beyond the hype to build AI solutions that actually work and deliver immediate value for an established, global client base. We are a remote\-first organization that fully supports a distributed culture built on trust, autonomy, and ownership. You’ll enjoy the agility and impact of a small, close\-knit company paired with the high\-stakes challenge of cutting\-edge technical projects. If you are looking for a culture of deep technical excellence where your work directly shapes the future of production\-ready AI, you belong with us.

**About The Company**
 America is under sustained cyber attack. Our adversaries infiltrate our networks, steal our intellectual property, and degrade the digital infrastructure that modern life depends on. These malicious activities often go unpunished, creating a significant threat to national security and economic stability. Recognizing the critical need for robust cybersecurity measures, Twenty was founded in 2024 with a mission to elevate the United States and its allies' dominance in cyberspace. Headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, Twenty specializes in industrializing offensive cyber operations to deter adversaries and strengthen national security. Backed by notable investors such as Accel, Caffeinated Capital, Friends \& Family Capital, Point72 Ventures, General Catalyst, and In\-Q\-Tel, the company has raised $138 million to develop innovative cyber capabilities that ensure deterrence and security in the digital age.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Machine Learning Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for building and deploying language\-model\-powered systems that enhance Twenty’s mission\-critical cyber capabilities for U.S. national security. You will oversee the entire lifecycle of AI development—from curating specialized datasets and fine\-tuning models to deploying reliable inference and retrieval systems in production environments. This position requires close collaboration with product and engineering teams to translate operational needs into high\-performing AI features. The environment is dynamic, operating across both cloud and on\-premises infrastructure, where speed, accuracy, and security are paramount. Your work will directly contribute to safeguarding national security and maintaining technological superiority.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Minimum of 4\+ years of professional experience in software development, specifically supporting ML/AI\-enabled applications.
* Strong proficiency in Python and extensive experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.
* Hands\-on experience with large language model (LLM) post\-training techniques, including continued pre\-training, supervised fine\-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), and other alignment methods like DPO, PPO, or GRPO.
* Proficiency in curating, cleaning, and preprocessing datasets for training and evaluation purposes.
* Working knowledge of relational, graph, and vector database concepts, including experience with tools like pgvector, ChromaDB, Pinecone, Milvus, or Weaviate.
* Experience designing and implementing evaluation metrics and testing procedures for LLMs and intelligent agents.
* Ability to integrate LLM and agent systems using frameworks such as Pydantic\-AI, LangChain/LangGraph, or CrewAI.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


**Responsibilities**
* Create, maintain, and refine high\-quality datasets for training and evaluating specialized AI models tailored to cybersecurity applications.
* Fine\-tune language models, ranging from small specialized models to medium\-sized foundation models, aligned with mission requirements.
* Implement post\-training and alignment strategies to enhance model performance, reliability, and safety.
* Develop retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems that ground model outputs using external knowledge bases to improve accuracy and contextual relevance.
* Design, develop, and optimize model serving infrastructure to support scalable, secure, and efficient deployment in production environments.
* Establish evaluation frameworks and testing harnesses to measure model quality, latency, and regression performance.
* Integrate AI capabilities into operational workflows and applications using modern orchestration frameworks and APIs.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams—including product managers, engineers, and security specialists—to identify high\-impact use cases and deliver innovative solutions.
* Document models, datasets, and operational procedures clearly and comprehensively to facilitate ongoing maintenance and knowledge sharing.

* On\-site amenities such as garage parking, bike storage, a fitness center, and a stipend for desk setup to promote a comfortable and productive work environment.

 Retrieval or embedding systems.

 So if you're ready to be part of something extraordinary — with a team that’s transforming commercial insurance — we want to meet you.
   

  

 Data Scientist
   

  

 We are looking for an Applied Data Scientist with 3\+ years of experience who has shipped models into production systems used by real end users. Insurance experience is not required — if you have built classification pipelines, scoring engines, or document extraction systems in fintech, healthcare, logistics, e\-commerce, or any other data\-rich, decision\-heavy domain, we want to hear from you. The domain knowledge transfer is something we can support; the engineering discipline and deployment experience are what matter most.
   

  

 We are an MGA — a company that designs, underwrites, and distributes specialty insurance products. Think of us as a high\-velocity decision engine: thousands of submissions come in, each requiring rapid evaluation against a set of complex, evolving criteria. We are building the AI infrastructure that makes those decisions faster, more consistent, and more accurate. The models you build will run inside that infrastructure.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Intake Scoring \& Automated Triage**
* Build and maintain the models that evaluate inbound requests in real time — scoring quality, flagging risk signals, and routing items to the right handling path before a human reviews them.
* Train classification and ranking models on historical outcome data (accepted, declined, loss events) to predict account quality and prioritize review queues — similar in structure to fraud scoring at fintechs, patient risk stratification in healthcare, or lead scoring in high\-volume sales platforms.
* Integrate structured and unstructured third\-party data signals as model features: geospatial layers, firmographic data, external risk indicators, and document\-extracted fields.
* Serve model outputs via API so scores and flags appear natively inside workflow tools used by the operations team — your model is a product feature, not a report.


**Automated Decision Logic**
* Translate business rules and decisioning criteria into machine\-executable logic that can be applied programmatically at intake — moving decisions that currently require human judgment into automated or assisted pathways.
* Build and own the feature engineering pipelines that feed these models: normalizing inputs, handling missing data, encoding categorical variables, and enriching records with external data sources.
* Develop model explainability layers so end users understand why a record was scored or routed a particular way — a requirement for user trust and, in our industry, regulatory defensibility.


**Model Deployment \& MLOps**
* Own the full deployment lifecycle: containerize models, write inference APIs, coordinate with engineering on production integration, and set up monitoring for model drift and performance degradation over time.
* Instrument deployed models with logging and alerting so the team detects underperformance before it shows up downstream — the same operational rigor expected in any production ML system, regardless of industry.
* Maintain model versioning and a rollback\-capable registry so changes can be audited, compared, and reversed — increasingly important in regulated environments.
* Contribute to shared ML infrastructure: feature stores, reusable pipeline components, and standardized evaluation frameworks used across the data team.


**Document \& Unstructured Data Processing**
* Build pipelines to extract structured data from unstructured documents: forms, PDFs, emails, and attachments that arrive as part of the intake workflow.
* Apply NLP and LLM\-based extraction techniques to reduce manual data entry and improve the completeness of records entering the decision workflow — analogous to document intelligence work in healthcare (clinical notes), legal tech (contract extraction), or lending (income verification documents).
* Develop confidence scoring for extracted fields so downstream systems know when to auto\-populate versus queue for human review.


**Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of experience as a data scientist or ML engineer, with several production deployments where your model ran inside a system used by real end users.
* Strong Python skills with production\-grade coding practices: modular, tested, version\-controlled code — not just notebook\-quality work.
* Hands\-on experience with ML frameworks (scikit\-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, or TensorFlow) and applied knowledge of classification, ranking, regression, and feature engineering for real\-world, noisy datasets.
* Experience building and maintaining data pipelines that feed production models — scheduled, monitored, and reliable, not just ad hoc EDA scripts.
* Familiarity with model deployment patterns: REST APIs (FastAPI or Flask), containerization (Docker), and cloud deployment on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Proficient in SQL; comfortable pulling and transforming data from a cloud warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift) as part of feature engineering workflows.
* Strong problem\-framing instincts: you can take an ambiguous business problem, identify whether ML is the right tool, define the target variable, and scope the modeling approach before writing a line of code.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in a domain with high\-volume, structured decisioning: fintech (credit scoring, fraud detection, loan underwriting), healthcare (risk stratification, claims adjudication, prior authorization), logistics (routing, demand forecasting), or e\-commerce (pricing, recommendation, fulfillment) — these backgrounds translate well and are actively valued.
* Prior experience in insurance, insurtech, or an MGA is a genuine plus, but not a requirement. Familiarity with concepts like loss ratio, submission triage, risk scoring, or policy lifecycle will shorten your ramp time and is worth noting in your application.
* Experience with LLMs and document intelligence pipelines: prompt engineering, RAG architectures, fine\-tuning, or extraction from semi\-structured documents (PDFs, forms, emails).
* MLOps tooling experience: MLflow, Weights \& Biases, SageMaker, Vertex AI, or equivalent platforms for model tracking, serving, and monitoring.
* Knowledge of model explainability techniques (SHAP, LIME) and experience designing systems where model outputs need to be interpretable by non\-technical end users.
* Experience integrating geospatial, firmographic, or third\-party enrichment data as ML features — not just as lookup tables, but as engineered inputs to a model.
* Familiarity with algorithmic fairness considerations and regulatory constraints on automated decisioning — relevant in insurance, lending, healthcare, and other regulated verticals.
